res.help: How many jobs may hold a resource at once. The queue reads this on every claim, so a change applies without a restart.

res.lowerHelp: Raising the limit lets waiting jobs start. Lowering it never stops a running job; it only holds back new ones.

job.unknownClass: This error class has no explanation yet.

resume.reason.not_failed: The job has not failed, so there is nothing to resume.
resume.reason.no_error_class: The failure has no recorded error class, so the effect of resuming cannot be determined.
resume.reason.unknown_error_class: The error class is not in the policy table, so the effect of resuming cannot be determined.
resume.reason.uncertain_outcome: The request may already have been accepted. Resuming could repeat it.
resume.reason.already_rewritten: A rewrite run already continues this run. Open that run instead.
resume.reason.rewrite_run: Retry starts one new rewrite run; this run is not changed.
resume.reason.upstream_recorded: Every earlier stage is completed and has a recorded execution, so only this stage runs again.
resume.reason.upstream_incomplete: An earlier stage is not completed, so its output cannot be confirmed.
resume.reason.no_execution_record: An earlier stage completed but left no execution record, so its inputs cannot be confirmed.
errclass.invalid_input.what: A stage rejected its input (for example an idea or setting it cannot use). Nothing is retried automatically.
errclass.invalid_input.next: Open the episode, fix the idea or settings named in the reason, then create a new episode or press Retry.
errclass.auth_or_permission.what: A service refused the credentials or permission it was given. Nothing is retried automatically.
errclass.auth_or_permission.next: Check the local service configuration and its access, fix it, then press Retry. Never paste a secret into the idea or notes.
errclass.rate_limited.what: A service asked us to slow down. The stage is retried automatically with a growing delay, up to the attempt limit.
errclass.rate_limited.next: Wait. If it still fails after the last attempt, press Retry later.
errclass.provider_outage.what: A service was down or returned a server error. The stage is retried automatically with a growing delay, up to the attempt limit.
errclass.provider_outage.next: Check that the local service (language model, image or voice engine) is running. Press Retry after the last attempt if it still fails.
errclass.uncertain_outcome.what: The request may or may not have been accepted, so repeating it could duplicate work or cost. It is never retried automatically.
errclass.uncertain_outcome.next: Check the service's own record of the request first. Press Retry only when you are sure it did not go through.
errclass.transient_network.what: A connection to a local service dropped or timed out. The stage is retried automatically with a growing delay.
errclass.transient_network.next: Usually nothing. If it keeps failing, check that the local service is running and reachable, then press Retry.
errclass.validation_failed.what: The model's output did not match the required structure, so it was not used. The stage is retried automatically.
errclass.validation_failed.next: Usually nothing. If it keeps failing, try a different model setting or simplify the idea, then press Retry.
errclass.unsupported.what: The request needs something this version cannot do (it makes a motion comic, not lip-synced animation). Nothing is retried.
errclass.unsupported.next: Change the idea so it does not need that effect. Retrying will fail the same way.
errclass.insufficient_local_resources.wh: The GPU, memory or disk was not free enough. The job waits and starts by itself when the resource has room.
errclass.insufficient_local_resources.ne: Close other heavy programs and wait. Only one GPU job runs at a time.
errclass.internal.what: An unexpected fault in the studio itself. Nothing is retried automatically.
errclass.internal.next: Press Retry once. If it fails again, note the job number and time and look in the server log for that job.
errclass.worker_restart.what: The worker stopped while running this stage (restart or crash). The stage is retried automatically from the last completed stage.
errclass.worker_restart.next: Nothing. Check the resume verdict below if you want to be sure earlier stages are intact.
errclass.qa_failed.what: A blocking quality check failed on the rendered video, so it cannot be approved as is.
errclass.qa_failed.next: Open the review page, read the failed rules and suggested fixes, fix the cause, then re-render.
errclass.script_duration.what: The script is too long or too short for the target length. Running the voice stage again on the same script would fail the same way.
errclass.script_duration.next: Press Retry: it starts one new rewrite run that sends this reason back to the scriptwriter. A run can be rewritten once.
errclass.cancelled.what: The run was cancelled by the owner.
errclass.cancelled.next: Nothing is broken. Start a re-render or create a new episode when you want to continue.
